main_result.name: QFORM-SCHUR-SPECTRAL-PACKET-RESERVE-v1
main_result.statement: For an original-coordinate pivot I, A0=[[C,B],[B^T,D]], and any signed packet E=U Theta U^T with C and C1=C+U0 Theta U0^T invertible, Schur_I(A0+E)=S0+Z K_Theta Z^T, Z=U1-B^T C^{-1}U0, K_Theta=Theta-Theta U0^T C1^{-1}U0 Theta. Hence a K-by-J Schur cross block changes by rank rho=rank(Z_K K_Theta Z_J^T), and s_q(M1)>=s_{q+rho}(M0), independent of eigenvalue magnitudes and signs.
main_result.small_spectrum_extension: For an arbitrary-rank signed tail T with ||T||<=h, if the post-large-packet pivot has mu=s_min(C1)>h and pivot-cross norm R, then ||Schur(A1+T)-Schur(A1)|| <= h + R^2 h/[mu(mu-h)] + (2Rh+h^2)/(mu-h).

partner_result_applied.name: QFORM-RANKONE-SELF-CARRIER-RETENTION-v1
partner_result_applied.actual_application: On m=7 baseline C0=4e1e1^T and Schur cross 2I6, an unbounded rank<=2 large cross packet plus arbitrary complement spectrum leaves s3 of the pre-tail carrier >=2. After arbitrary signed ||T||<=0.01, the final-matrix partner parameters obey g>=1.99, c>=3.99, b<=0.01, alpha>=0.56, h_i<=0.01, Delta_R1>=1.9793840196887886, yielding ||p_Q||_(infinity,ess)<8.964.

exact_target_check: The same final family satisfies s3(A)>=s3(P_H A)>=1.99>1, hence has at least three eigenvalues of absolute value >=1.99.
finite_check_status: 500 random algebra checks; max Schur identity error 1.44e-11; zero rank or interlacing violations. Sanity check only, not proof.
unresolved_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, force either an original-coordinate pivot/bank split with Schur singular-value reserve exceeding the graph-residual rank and a usable pivot, or a completed non-Schur exit. Pivot singularity requires re-pivoting; it cannot be divided through.
next_step: Prove an alignment-versus-transverse-volume/pivot dichotomy: low Schur graph-residual dimension gives the present theorem; high residual dimension should force projected-crossing or diffuse-bank volume.
